svg.title: Ysolde Thane, Pilgrim of the Unwritten Sign

text.tspan: Ysolde Thane, Pilgrim of the Unwritten Sign
Fast. When this resolves, look at the top card of your
Archive; you may put it into your Hand instead of leaving
Ysolde Thane reads the Unwritten Clause the way The Starweave
Communion always has: as proof the Tangle can still be
renegotiated, if you find the moment it left open.
